01 — About

Who we are

No mission statement, no manifesto. Just a straightforward account of a group and what it does.

PCG Promitheas Veria is a gang. In Veria, people know the name — and they're careful around it.

The group launched in early summer 2026. Since then, more than 10,000 people have asked to join.

Beyond day-to-day activities, the group periodically runs giveaways for its members and followers. Details of each giveaway are announced through the Instagram account linked on this page.

Group giveaways

Featured giveaway

Guess the score

One recurring format: predict the correct scoreline for an upcoming match. Members submit a guess before kickoff; the closest prediction wins.

This edition featured a fixture between Spain and Saudi Arabia. Past and upcoming giveaways are posted with full rules and deadlines on Instagram.
